nodes.description: Halo3D external token contract reference stored in AcceptsHalo3D; used for myTokens/myDividends/transfer/reinvest calls.
Public constant (86400) used to convert eggs into shrimp and to cap elapsed time.
Public starting shrimp amount (300), unused in logic.
Trade-balancing constant PSN=10000 used by calculateTrade.
Trade-balancing constant PSNH=5000 used by calculateTrade.
Game activation flag; gates tokenFallback, hatchEggs and sellEggs and is set by seedMarket.
Contract owner set to msg.sender in the constructor; recipient of dev fees and gate for seedMarket.
Mapping of user shrimp holdings; read by getMyShrimp and getEggsSinceLastHatch, written by hatchEggs.
Mapping of un-hatched egg balances; credited in tokenFallback and reset in hatchEggs/sellEggs.
Mapping of last hatch timestamps (now); drives time-based egg accrual.
Mapping of referrer addresses written in hatchEggs and paid 20% of used eggs.
Global market egg reserve used both as trade input and as a sink in hatchEggs/sellEggs.
Constructor that sets ceoAddress = msg.sender and forwards _baseContract to AcceptsHalo3D.
Empty payable fallback that accepts ETH and does nothing.
ERC677 hook with onlyTokenContract modifier; buys eggs, calls reinvest, performs external token transfers and credits claimedEggs after the external call.
Converts accrued eggs into shrimp, sets referrals, pays referral eggs and boosts marketEggs.
Sells accrued eggs for tokens, charges dev fee, resets user state and performs two external token transfers.
One-time CEO-only seeding of marketEggs and activation of initialized.
Calls tokenContract.reinvest() when the farm has more than 1 dividend unit, causing an external call.
Magic trade balancing algorithm using PSN/PSNH and SafeMath mul/div.
Computes egg sell value from marketEggs and tokenContract.myTokens().
Computes eggs bought for a token amount and contract balance.
Convenience wrapper around calculateEggBuy using tokenContract.myTokens().
Returns 4% of an amount using SafeMath mul/div.
Returns hatcheryShrimp[msg.sender].
Returns claimedEggs[msg.sender] plus eggs accrued since last hatch.
Time-dependent egg accrual using now - lastHatch[adr], capped by min().
Reads tokenContract.myDividends(true).
Reads tokenContract.myTokens().
Uses inline assembly extcodesize to detect contract callers in tokenFallback.
Private pure minimum helper.
msg.sender: caller identity, used for ownership, referral, balances and payout recipient.
block.timestamp (now): miner-controllable time used for lastHatch and egg accrual.
External call tokenContract.transfer(ceoAddress, devFee(_value)) executed in tokenFallback.
External call tokenContract.transfer(ceoAddress, fee) executed in sellEggs.
External call tokenContract.transfer(msg.sender, eggValue - fee) executed in sellEggs.
External call tokenContract.reinvest() executed in reinvest.
Inline assembly extcodesize(_user) used for contract detection (bypassable during construction).
Raw a * b multiplication inside SafeMath.mul guarded only by assert(c / a == b).
Constructor parameter with the base Halo3D token address.
tokenFallback parameter identifying the token sender credited with eggs.
tokenFallback parameter with the token amount transferred.
tokenFallback metadata parameter (unused).
hatchEggs referrer address parameter.
seedMarket parameter with the initial egg supply.
calculateTrade parameter for the resource in the trade.
calculateTrade parameter for the reserve in the trade.
calculateTrade parameter for the buy/sell amount.
calculateEggSell parameter with the egg amount to value.
calculateEggBuy parameter with the token amount being spent.
calculateEggBuy parameter with the current contract token balance.
calculateEggBuySimple parameter with the token amount.
devFee parameter with the amount to take 4% of.
getEggsSinceLastHatch parameter with the account queried.
_isContract parameter holding the address to test with extcodesize.
min() first operand.
min() second operand.
AcceptsHalo3D constructor parameter used to set tokenContract.
tokenFallback local holding eggs bought, net of dev fee.
tokenFallback local holding tokenContract.myTokens() snapshot.
hatchEggs local holding the user's accrued eggs before conversion.
hatchEggs local holding eggsUsed / EGGS_TO_HATCH_1SHRIMP.
sellEggs local holding the user's accrued eggs.
sellEggs local holding the token value of the eggs.
sellEggs local holding the 4% dev fee of eggValue.
getEggsSinceLastHatch local holding min(EGGS_TO_HATCH_1SHRIMP, now - lastHatch).
_isContract local holding the extcodesize result.
SafeMath.mul local c = a * b, the unchecked product.
Base constructor that stores the Halo3D token address in tokenContract.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns ceoAddress = msg.sender, making the caller the privileged owner.
seedMarket gates initialization with require(msg.sender == ceoAddress).
hatchEggs uses msg.sender for referrals, claimedEggs, hatcheryShrimp and lastHatch.
sellEggs resets and pays balances indexed by msg.sender.
The payout transfer in sellEggs sends tokens to msg.sender.
getMyShrimp reads hatcheryShrimp[msg.sender].
getMyEggs reads claimedEggs[msg.sender].
getEggsSinceLastHatch depends on block.timestamp via now - lastHatch[adr].
hatchEggs writes lastHatch[msg.sender] = now, a timestamp dependency.
sellEggs writes lastHatch[msg.sender] = now, a timestamp dependency.
marketEggs is a trade input to calculateTrade.
hatchEggs increases marketEggs with eggsUsed/10.
sellEggs increases marketEggs with hasEggs.
seedMarket initializes marketEggs = eggs.
calculateEggSell passes marketEggs as the reserve.
calculateEggBuy uses marketEggs as the buy-side liquidity.
lastHatch[adr] determines secondsPassed.
hatcheryShrimp[adr] multiplies secondsPassed to yield accrued eggs.
hatchEggs adds newShrimp to hatcheryShrimp[msg.sender].
getMyShrimp returns hatcheryShrimp[msg.sender].
getMyEggs sums claimedEggs[msg.sender].
tokenFallback credits claimedEggs[_from] after the external transfer.
hatchEggs resets claimedEggs[msg.sender] to 0.
sellEggs resets claimedEggs[msg.sender] to 0.
hatchEggs reads and writes referrals[msg.sender].
EGGS_TO_HATCH_1SHRIMP caps secondsPassed through min().
PSN constant is multiplied into the trade formula.
PSNH constant is added into the trade formula.
tokenFallback requires initialized.
hatchEggs requires initialized.
sellEggs requires initialized.
seedMarket sets initialized = true.
tokenFallback reads tokenContract.myTokens() and calls tokenContract.transfer().
sellEggs performs tokenContract.transfer() twice.
reinvest reads tokenContract.myDividends() and calls reinvest().
calculateEggSell reads tokenContract.myTokens().
calculateEggBuy depends on the contract token balance passed in.
getContractDividends reads tokenContract.myDividends(true).
getBalance reads tokenContract.myTokens().
sellEggs calls reinvest() before its external transfers.
tokenFallback calls reinvest() before crediting eggs.
tokenFallback calls calculateEggBuy to size the purchase.
tokenFallback calls devFee twice.
sellEggs calls devFee on eggValue.
sellEggs calls getMyEggs.
sellEggs calls calculateEggSell.
hatchEggs calls getMyEggs.
calculateEggSell calls calculateTrade.
calculateEggBuy calls calculateTrade.
calculateEggBuySimple calls calculateEggBuy.
getMyEggs calls getEggsSinceLastHatch.
getEggsSinceLastHatch caps elapsed time using min().
tokenFallback calls _isContract(_from) to reject contract senders.
tokenFallback executes the external tokenContract.transfer(ceoAddress, devFee(_value)) call.
sellEggs executes the external dev-fee transfer to ceoAddress.
sellEggs executes the external payout transfer to msg.sender.
reinvest executes the external tokenContract.reinvest() call.
_isContract computes the caller size via inline assembly extcodesize.
calculateTrade relies on SafeMath.mul for PSN*bs and similar products.
devFee relies on SafeMath.mul(amount, 4).
The external transfer in tokenFallback can reenter tokenFallback before claimedEggs[_from] is credited.
The external transfer in tokenFallback can reenter the state-mutating hatchEggs.
The external payout transfer to msg.sender can reenter sellEggs.
The external dev-fee transfer can reenter sellEggs before completion.
The external tokenContract.reinvest() call can reenter reinvest.
_baseContract is forwarded to the AcceptsHalo3D constructor.
_from is the account credited with eggs in tokenFallback.
_value drives the egg purchase and dev fee in tokenFallback.
_data is accepted but unused by tokenFallback.
ref is recorded in referrals[msg.sender].
eggs is the seed supply passed into seedMarket.
seedMarket writes marketEggs = eggs.
rt is the trade resource input to calculateTrade.
rs is the trade reserve input to calculateTrade.
bs is the trade amount input to calculateTrade.
eggs is valued in calculateEggSell.
eth is the amount spent in calculateEggBuy.
contractBalance is the reserve in calculateEggBuy.
eth is forwarded to calculateEggBuy from calculateEggBuySimple.
amount is used to compute the 4% dev fee.
adr indexes lastHatch and hatcheryShrimp.
_user is the address measured with extcodesize.
a is the first operand of min.
b is the second operand of min.
_tokenContract is the address stored by the base constructor.
AcceptsHalo3D constructor sets tokenContract = Halo3D(_tokenContract).
eggsBought is the net egg amount credited in tokenFallback.
halo3DBalance snapshots the token balance used by tokenFallback.
halo3DBalance is assigned from tokenContract.myTokens().
eggsUsed is the accrued egg amount converted in hatchEggs.
newShrimp is the shrimp amount added in hatchEggs.
hasEggs is the accrued egg amount valued in sellEggs.
eggValue is the token proceeds computed in sellEggs.
fee is subtracted and sent to ceoAddress in sellEggs.
secondsPassed drives the egg accrual computation.
size holds the extcodesize result compared against 0.
c is the raw a * b product inside SafeMath.mul.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter _baseContract only exists to feed the AcceptsHalo3D constructor call inside fn_constructor_Halo3DShrimpFarmer.
_from is the credited account parameter of tokenFallback and carries no independent meaning.
_value is the input amount consumed by tokenFallback's purchase math.
_data is an unused ERC677 metadata parameter of tokenFallback.
ref is the referral parameter stored by hatchEggs.
eggs is the seed amount parameter of seedMarket.
rt is a trade operand of calculateTrade.
rs is a trade operand of calculateTrade.
bs is a trade operand of calculateTrade.
eggs is the valuation parameter of calculateEggSell.
eth is the spend amount parameter of calculateEggBuy.
contractBalance is the reserve parameter of calculateEggBuy.
eth is the passthrough parameter of calculateEggBuySimple.
amount is the fee base parameter of devFee.
adr indexes the state read by getEggsSinceLastHatch.
_user is the address probed by _isContract's extcodesize.
a is the first comparison operand of min.
b is the second comparison operand of min.
_tokenContract is only used to set tokenContract in the AcceptsHalo3D constructor.
eggsBought is an intermediate value scoped to tokenFallback.
halo3DBalance is an intermediate token balance snapshot inside tokenFallback.
eggsUsed is a transient value computed and consumed inside hatchEggs.
newShrimp is a transient value added to hatcheryShrimp inside hatchEggs.
hasEggs is a transient accrued-egg value inside sellEggs.
eggValue is a transient token valuation inside sellEggs.
fee is a transient dev-fee value inside sellEggs.
secondsPassed is a transient time delta inside getEggsSinceLastHatch.
size is the transient extcodesize result inside _isContract.
c is the raw multiplication result produced by the SafeMath.mul unsafely-checked operation.
